transcript: Water alone doesn't hydrate you. What actually hydrates you is salt. But not the white powder they sell you as salt. That's processed sodium with no life in it. Real salt has over 80 minerals that your body needs to function. When you drink water without minerals, your body just lets it pass through without absorbing it, in and out. That's why some people drink liters of water and are still dehydrated, because water without minerals doesn't stay. Real salt tells your cells to open up and hold onto that water where they need it. Here's how you do it. When you wake up, put a pinch of natural, unrefined salt in the palm of your hand. Place it under your tongue and let it dissolve. Then prepare a glass of water with a juice of half a lemon and add another pinch of salt. Drink it slowly. The salt under your tongue gets absorbed directly into your bloodstream and mineralizes your body before you've even had breakfast. The lemon activates your liver and boosts absorption. And the water with salt reaches where it needs to reach, because now it actually has the minerals that tell your cells to hold onto it. In our monastery, we never drink water without minerals. Because we know that empty water doesn't hydrate, it just passes through. From the very first day, you're going to notice your energy going up, your mind getting clearer and that constant thirst you had just disappearing. But I want you to understand something. Dehydration doesn't only come from not drinking enough water. Stress dehydrates you. Cortisol disrupts your fluid and electrolyte balance, and your body loses minerals every time you go through a stressful day. Anxiety drives you out from the inside. That's why some people drink water all day long and still have a dry mouth, chapped lips and an exhausted body, because they're hydrating, but the stress is stripping their minerals faster than they can replace them. Write S-A-L in the comments if you're going to start tomorrow. And if you want to stop emptying yourself from the inside, I've spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do that. And everything I know is inside the Path Back to Calm. The link is in my profile.
